snippet.title: Explosive Odds Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Gamble with your life in this explosive PvP game for 2-4 players. Cut wires, earn cash, use abilities and avoid the detonators. Test your luck, skills and remember to always bet on the boom!

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3674980/Explosive_Odds/
Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/y7guXuWJqP
